label: requires capability
type: subject = a feature or setting; object = a capability of the underlying bucket type, storage engine or edition that must be present for the subject to be usable; means the subject is unavailable without it.
note: Promoted as the general form of a constraint the corpus keeps restating in specific ways. Its motivating instance is the sharpest cross-family fact this round found: durability:level-persist-to-majority requires disk persistence, which bucket:ephemeral-bucket does not have, so a bucket-type choice silently removes a durability level. Overlaps in spirit with requiresEdition and doesNotSupport, and the boundary is worth watching - if a later round finds it absorbing their occurrences, consolidate then, with the citation, rather than pre-emptively now.
